verdict: Leads are coming in efficiently; the gap is converting them to cases.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 182 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $11.76 — and that cost dropped another 11% in the most recent week while lead volume grew, meaning the campaign is getting more efficient, not less. The problem is downstream: your pipeline shows 0 opportunities created from those leads, which means inquiries are arriving but not advancing to intake. That is an intake process gap, not an ads problem, and tightening that hand-off is the immediate priority. Google Business Profile engagement also went quiet over the last several days, and a posting cadence is being restarted to restore that local signal. Next period, expect continued cost-per-lead improvement on Meta and clearer visibility into how many leads are moving to consultations as the intake process is addressed.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta
cost per lead this period, down 11% versus the prior week
pipeline opportunities created from those 182 leads

watch_item.issue: 182 leads have arrived but none have been logged as opportunities in the pipeline, pointing to a gap in the intake or follow-up process.
watch_item.fix: We are working with your team to close the intake hand-off so leads move into the pipeline and can be tracked through to cases.
